title: Fix Linux ReMCP uninstall after migration from systemd-user to PID-1 systemd.
changes: Stop and remove both ReMCP-owned system and legacy user units, rather than leaving a stale user unit behind.
Preflight both units for ownership, refuse foreign or symlinked unit files, and surface failed service stops or reloads.
Make status show no supervisor after uninstall and distinguish a retained CLI and pairing from a running agent.
Show a clear uninstall confirmation; ordinary uninstall keeps paired credentials and CLI, while --purge additionally removes global npm packages.
Cover dual-supervisor cleanup, foreign-unit protection, failed-stop behavior, symlinks, and an isolated CLI uninstall fixture.
